name: What permits are required for stone stair installation in Los Angeles County?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for stone stair installation in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit requirements for stone stair installation in Los Angeles County depend on the scope and location of the project. Minor repairs or replacements of existing stairs might not require a permit if they don't alter the structure's footprint or height. However, building new stairs, significantly altering existing ones, or projects involving excavation, retaining walls, or structural changes often require building permits. It's crucial to consult with your local city's planning or building department (e.g., Los Angeles, Pasadena, San Marino) as regulations can vary. Our firm can assist in navigating these permit processes.
